AliMed has always been shaped by a simple idea: better solutions start with understanding the
everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

Our products are just the beginning. Clinical expertise, technology and genuine commitment work
together to drive real outcomes for your team.

[Explore Our Products][76][Shop or Rent Products][77][Find Support][78]
[Baxter International Professional Site for US Healthcare Providers]

efforts, realize staff and task efficiencies, strengthen care coordination and enhance the clinician
and patient experience. Our approach unifies Baxter devices and applications onto one modern
platform, with solutions focused on these areas:

integrate with electronic healthcare records and other hospital systems.

Our products are just the beginning. Clinical expertise, technology and genuine commitment work
together to drive real outcomes for your team.

[Explore Our Products][76][Shop or Rent Products][77][Find Support][78]
[Baxter International Professional Site for US Healthcare Providers]

## Leading the Way with Our Most Connected Delivery System Yet

Working side by side with customers, we’re advancing connected solutions that enable patient safety
efforts, realize staff and task efficiencies, strengthen care coordination and enhance the clinician
and patient experience. Our approach unifies Baxter devices and applications onto one modern
platform, with solutions focused on these areas:

[The Centrella hospital bed in a med-surg unit]

### Connected Bedside

Smart beds, vital signs monitors, infusion pumps, nurse call and clinical communication systems can
integrate with electronic healthcare records and other hospital systems.

[Explore Smart Beds and Surfaces][79]
[A clinician places his hand on a patient’s shoulder while talking in a primary care office.]

### Connected Outpatient Office

Integrate data from vital signs monitors, enhance physical exams with digital tools and deliver
connected vision screenings and retinal exams.

[Explore Diagnostics and Examination Products][80]
[Cardiology Technician examines an ECG next to a patient with electrodes on his chest]

### Connected Cardiac Care

Connected cardiac care integrates data from multiple diagnostic devices and modalities, including
ECG and ambulatory monitoring.

[Explore Cardiac Care Solutions][81]

Diagnostics and Examination

## **Connex** 360 Vital Signs Monitor

With an upgradeable and expandable design, the **Welch Allyn Connex** 360 Vital Signs Monitor
features optimized clinician workflows for connected monitoring and enhanced security features.

[Connex 360 Vital Signs Monitor][82][All Diagnostics and Examination Products][83]
[Healthcare checking vitals on the Connex 360 and patient]

## **One portfolio.** Multiple categories. The right product for every need.

From beds and patient mobility to care communication, infusion, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals,
respiratory and surgical technologies, discover innovations that can soon transform care in your
setting.

Communications Pharmaceuticals Respiratory Therapy and Devices Surgical Equipment and Technologies

Beds and Patient Mobility

Baxter’s smart beds, surfaces, and mobility products are the center of the connected patient room,
enhancing comfort, streamlining work and delivering important data to your team to aid in a faster
response.
* Smart Beds and Surfaces
* Patient Handling and Mobility
* Stretchers

[All Beds and Patient Mobility][84]
[The bottom of a Centrella bed, projecting lights on the floor]

Infusion Therapies and Technologies

Empower your team to deliver safe, efficient care with our connected infusion systems, IV fluids and
parenteral nutrition solutions, all backed by our broad supply chain network.
* Clinical Nutrition
* Infusion Systems and Accessories
* IV Solutions

[All Infusion Therapies and Technologies][85]
[Baxter Novum Syringe Pump]

Diagnostics and Examination

Equip yourself with trusted **Welch Allyn** exam tools, vital signs monitors, cardiac care devices
and vision screening systems designed to support better outcomes for your patients. Decades of
innovation and reliability come together to support every care setting, including the physician’s
office, clinic, hospital and urgent care.
* Patient Monitoring Solutions
* Cardiac Care Solutions
* Physical Exam and Diagnostics
* Vision and Retinal Screening 

[All Diagnostics and Examination][86]
[Healthcare worker with patient]

Care Communications

Get vital information to the right team with our unified suite of communications solutions that
connect patients, clinicians, devices and data across your entire organization. Solutions include
nurse call, hands-free communication, mobile communication and alert and alarm management.
* Nurse Call
* Mobile Applications
* Voice-Activated Communications
* Data Visualization and Management
* Precision Locating
* Patient Experience

[All Care Communications][87]
[baxter_voalte_nurse_call]

Pharmaceuticals

Our pharmaceutical products provide total coverage for your hospital, including anesthesia,
anti-infective, critical care and cardiac medications. These medicines are available from Baxter in
ready-to-use formulations, vials, cannisters and more.
* Premixed Medications
* Anesthetics
* Vials and Other Injectables
* Frozen Premixed Medications

[All Pharmaceuticals][88]
[Healthcare worker hangs an IV bag for chemotherapy]

Respiratory Therapy and Devices

Breathing should never be a barrier to living life fully. Our respiratory solutions support patients
by mobilizing secretions, easing the burden of chronic conditions and more. Treating conditions like
cystic fibrosis, bronchiectasis and neuromuscular disorders, our therapies help patients breathe
easily and live with confidence.
* Cough Assist Systems
* Airway Clearance Systems
* Patient Home Care Products

[All Respiratory Therapy and Devices][89]
[Patient breathing with respiratory asistance]

Surgical Equipment and Technologies

From emergency to elective surgeries, we offer surgical products and technologies to enhance
technique, help increase efficiencies and support patient recovery.
* Adhesion Reduction Technology
* Adjunctive Hemostats and Sealants
* Bone Repair Technology
* Lights and Booms
* Operating Room Integration
* Surgical Tables and Positioning Accessories
* Tissue Repair Technology

[All Surgical Equipment and Technologies][90]
[Surgeon in an operating room adjusts Helux Pro surgical light]

Care Communications

## **Voalte Linq** Device Powered by **Scotty** Assistant

**Voalte Linq** is next-gen, voice-activated technology for care teams, seamlessly integrating into
Baxter's ecosystem to support efficiency, safety and collaboration - so caregivers can focus on what
matters most: patient care.

[Voalte Linq][91][All Care Communication Products][92]
[FLC_Med-Surg_Nurse-Station]

## **IQX** Infusion Platform

The** IQX **Infusion Platform unites two proven technologies, the **Spectrum IQ **Large Volume Pump
(LVP) and the **Novum IQ** Syringe Pump (SYR), to create an enhanced infusion delivery ecosystem,
powered by the **IQ Enterprise** Connectivity Suite. 

[IQX Infusion Platform][93][All Infusion Therapies and Technologies][94]
[baxter_iqx_platform]

Beds and Patient Mobility

## **Dynamo Series** Stretcher

See what makes the **Dynamo Series** designed for the toughest. With features designed to help
support patient fall prevention, care team experience and patient comfort, the **Dynamo Series**
delivers a new standard of support where you need it most. 

[Dynamo Stretcher][95][All Beds and Patient Mobility Products][96]
[Healthcare worker helps a patient up from a Dynamo Series Stretcher]

Driven by compassion and powered by innovation, we deliver connected solutions that transform

outcomes, streamline workflows and create meaningful advancements for patients everywhere.

# Redefining what a healthcare company can do. 

Our products are just the beginning. Clinical expertise, technology and genuine commitment work
together to drive real outcomes for your team.

[Explore Our Products][76][Shop or Rent Products][77][Find Support][78]
[Baxter International Professional Site for US Healthcare Providers]

## Leading the Way with Our Most Connected Delivery System Yet

Working side by side with customers, we’re advancing connected solutions that enable patient safety
efforts, realize staff and task efficiencies, strengthen care coordination and enhance the clinician
and patient experience. Our approach unifies Baxter devices and applications onto one modern
platform, with solutions focused on these areas:

[The Centrella hospital bed in a med-surg unit]

### Connected Bedside

Smart beds, vital signs monitors, infusion pumps, nurse call and clinical communication systems can
integrate with electronic healthcare records and other hospital systems.

[Explore Smart Beds and Surfaces][79]
[A clinician places his hand on a patient’s shoulder while talking in a primary care office.]

### Connected Outpatient Office

Integrate data from vital signs monitors, enhance physical exams with digital tools and deliver
connected vision screenings and retinal exams.

[Explore Diagnostics and Examination Products][80]
[Cardiology Technician examines an ECG next to a patient with electrodes on his chest]

### Connected Cardiac Care

Connected cardiac care integrates data from multiple diagnostic devices and modalities, including
ECG and ambulatory monitoring.

[Explore Cardiac Care Solutions][81]

Diagnostics and Examination

## **Connex** 360 Vital Signs Monitor

With an upgradeable and expandable design, the **Welch Allyn Connex** 360 Vital Signs Monitor
features optimized clinician workflows for connected monitoring and enhanced security features.

[Connex 360 Vital Signs Monitor][82][All Diagnostics and Examination Products][83]
[Healthcare checking vitals on the Connex 360 and patient]

From beds and patient mobility to care communication, infusion, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals,
respiratory and surgical technologies, discover innovations that can soon transform care in your
setting.

response.

* Clinical Nutrition
* Infusion Systems and Accessories

[All Infusion Therapies and Technologies][85]
[Baxter Novum Syringe Pump]

Equip yourself with trusted **Welch Allyn** exam tools, vital signs monitors, cardiac care devices
and vision screening systems designed to support better outcomes for your patients. Decades of

office, clinic, hospital and urgent care.
* Patient Monitoring Solutions

* Physical Exam and Diagnostics
* Vision and Retinal Screening 

[All Diagnostics and Examination][86]
[Healthcare worker with patient]

Care Communications

Get vital information to the right team with our unified suite of communications solutions that
connect patients, clinicians, devices and data across your entire organization. Solutions include
nurse call, hands-free communication, mobile communication and alert and alarm management.
* Nurse Call
* Mobile Applications
* Voice-Activated Communications
* Data Visualization and Management
* Precision Locating
* Patient Experience

[All Care Communications][87]
[baxter_voalte_nurse_call]

Pharmaceuticals

Our pharmaceutical products provide total coverage for your hospital, including anesthesia,
anti-infective, critical care and cardiac medications. These medicines are available from Baxter in
ready-to-use formulations, vials, cannisters and more.
* Premixed Medications
* Anesthetics
* Vials and Other Injectables

[All Pharmaceuticals][88]
[Healthcare worker hangs an IV bag for chemotherapy]

Respiratory Therapy and Devices

Breathing should never be a barrier to living life fully. Our respiratory solutions support patients
by mobilizing secretions, easing the burden of chronic conditions and more. Treating conditions like
cystic fibrosis, bronchiectasis and neuromuscular disorders, our therapies help patients breathe
easily and live with confidence.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

FAQs

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about our engineering lab equipment, custom solutions,
exports and installation services. For anything not covered here, reach our team directly.

[Ask Us a Question][24]

### What products does Astra Scientific manufacture?

Astra Scientific manufactures a comprehensive range of engineering teaching aids including
**pneumatic trainers, mechatronics training equipment, CNC trainer milling machines, electrical
machine labs, electronics circuit trainers, fluid mechanics setups, heat transfer apparatus,
autotronics systems and hydraulic trainers**. We also supply complete TVET lab solutions, science
lab equipment, and medical & hospital lab products for educational and institutional use.

### Do you ship internationally and handle export tenders?

Yes — Astra Scientific exports to 45+ countries across Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, Uganda,
Nigeria, Ghana, Ethiopia, etc.), Asia, the Middle East and beyond. We are experienced in **MOE
tenders, World Bank tenders, UN tenders** and government institutional procurement processes, with
full documentation support, certifications and on-site installation services.

### Can you design custom lab equipment for our curriculum?

Absolutely. Our engineering team designs **custom training equipment** tailored to your specific
syllabus, lab dimensions and budget. From specification consulting to CAD design, prototyping,
manufacturing and final commissioning, we handle the complete turnkey project.

### What warranty and after-sales support do you provide?

All Astra Scientific equipment ships with a standard **1-year manufacturer warranty** (extendable on
request). We provide comprehensive installation, faculty training, technical manuals, experiment
books, and lifetime spares support. Remote troubleshooting and on-site service are available
worldwide.

### How do I request a quote or product catalog?

Simply email us at [info@astrascientific.com][25] or use the [contact form][26] with your
requirements. We respond to all enquiries within 24 hours with a detailed proposal, technical
datasheets and competitive pricing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to the most common questions about our engineering lab equipment, custom solutions,
exports and installation services. For anything not covered here, reach our team directly.

[Ask Us a Question][24]

### What products does Astra Scientific manufacture?

Astra Scientific manufactures a comprehensive range of engineering teaching aids including
**pneumatic trainers, mechatronics training equipment, CNC trainer milling machines, electrical
machine labs, electronics circuit trainers, fluid mechanics setups, heat transfer apparatus,
autotronics systems and hydraulic trainers**. We also supply complete TVET lab solutions, science
lab equipment, and medical & hospital lab products for educational and institutional use.

### Do you ship internationally and handle export tenders?

Yes — Astra Scientific exports to 45+ countries across Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, Uganda,
Nigeria, Ghana, Ethiopia, etc.), Asia, the Middle East and beyond. We are experienced in **MOE
tenders, World Bank tenders, UN tenders** and government institutional procurement processes, with
full documentation support, certifications and on-site installation services.

### Can you design custom lab equipment for our curriculum?

Absolutely. Our engineering team designs **custom training equipment** tailored to your specific
syllabus, lab dimensions and budget. From specification consulting to CAD design, prototyping,
manufacturing and final commissioning, we handle the complete turnkey project.

### What warranty and after-sales support do you provide?

All Astra Scientific equipment ships with a standard **1-year manufacturer warranty** (extendable on
request). We provide comprehensive installation, faculty training, technical manuals, experiment
books, and lifetime spares support. Remote troubleshooting and on-site service are available
worldwide.

### How do I request a quote or product catalog?

Simply email us at [info@astrascientific.com][25] or use the [contact form][26] with your
requirements. We respond to all enquiries within 24 hours with a detailed proposal, technical
datasheets and competitive pricing.

* ### [How to choose an electric wheelchair suitable for the elderly?][157]
  
  1. Safety: The elderly and the disabled have limited mobility and use electric wheelchairs to
  ensure safety is the first priority.
  The safety design of the [outdoor electric wheelchair][158] mainly includes: anti-backward small
  wheels, seat belts, anti-skid tires, electromagnetic brakes, and differential motors. In addition,
  two points should be noted: first, the center of gravity of the electric wheelchair should not be
  too high; second, the wheelchair will not slide on the slope and can stop smoothly.
  2. Comfort
  Comfort mainly refers to the seat system of the wheelchair, involving seat width, cushion
  material, backrest height, etc. Cushion material and backrest height, generally sofa chair + high
  backrest is the most comfortable.
  3. Portability
  Portability is the biggest point linked to personal needs. Pure mobility wheelchairs are generally
  easy to fold and store, while functional wheelchairs and long battery life are relatively heavy
  and not portable.

* ### [How to choose an electric wheelchair suitable for the elderly?][157]
  
  1. Safety: The elderly and the disabled have limited mobility and use electric wheelchairs to
  ensure safety is the first priority.
  The safety design of the [outdoor electric wheelchair][158] mainly includes: anti-backward small
  wheels, seat belts, anti-skid tires, electromagnetic brakes, and differential motors. In addition,
  two points should be noted: first, the center of gravity of the electric wheelchair should not be
  too high; second, the wheelchair will not slide on the slope and can stop smoothly.
  2. Comfort
  Comfort mainly refers to the seat system of the wheelchair, involving seat width, cushion
  material, backrest height, etc. Cushion material and backrest height, generally sofa chair + high
  backrest is the most comfortable.
  3. Portability
  Portability is the biggest point linked to personal needs. Pure mobility wheelchairs are generally
  easy to fold and store, while functional wheelchairs and long battery life are relatively heavy
  and not portable.
